class.name: UZUPostEffect
class.brief_description: Edge contrast and vignette for the U.ZU look, as a compositor effect.
class.description: A [CompositorEffect] that runs after transparent geometry on the HDR color: it strengthens the light-dark contrast at edges (an unsharp mask), so forms read more clearly, and darkens the corners (vignette), which draws the eye to the center. [method UZULook.apply_to_scene] adds it at [constant UZULook.QUALITY_HIGH] and [constant UZULook.QUALITY_STANDARD]. It runs on the Forward+ and Mobile renderers with a 16-bit float color buffer, and does nothing in the Compatibility renderer.

members.member: How strongly edges are sharpened. [code]0.0[/code] turns it off.
How much the corners are darkened, from [code]0.0[/code] (none) to [code]1.0[/code] (black corners).
